page.overview:
Who is Abdul-Qaadir?

Abdul-Qaadir bin Shereef is a morally corrupt Arabyan merchant, deeply entrenched in illegal activities in the Tilean city of Miragliano. Abdul-Qaadir is of Arabyan descent and has lived in Miragliano for the past ten years. He primarily deals in Crimson Shade and other narcotic herbs sourced from the South Lands, as his connections and influence stretch beyond local boundaries to international trade networks.

He is known for being ruthless and cruel, characteristics that make him feared and respected within the criminal community. His lack of morals and fear of neither god nor man further solidify his notoriety. Beyond his narcotic trade, Abdul-Qaadir engages in slaving and black market dealings.

Abdul-Qaadir operates out of a warehouse located off La Strada di Falco. This warehouse is not just a storage space but also serves as a fortified base for his operations, heavily guarded by competent security personnel.

Unlike many other criminals who might skimp on security, Abdul-Qaadir invests wisely in protecting his assets. His guards are well-trained and not the typical low-level thugs, indicating his serious approach to safeguarding his interests.
